title: Typology of Risks of Generative Text-to-Image Models

bias_targets.methodology: Systematic literature review and taxonomy development categorizing representational harms, Western-centric representation skew, and racial stereotypes in text-to-image models.

Systematic literature review and taxonomy development categorizing representational harms, including gendered occupational stereotypes, cisheteronormativity, and stereotypes against non-cisgender identities.
Systematic literature review synthesizing findings from existing empirical papers on how text-to-image models perpetuate stereotypes related to social class.
Systematic literature review identifying representational harms and elements of ableism encoded within generative model outputs.
Systematic literature review identifying gaps in empirical research regarding religious bias and the potential for culturally offensive or taboo generations.
Systematic literature review noting ageism as a neglected output bias in current text-to-image research.
Systematic literature review evaluating how text-to-image systems favor white-aligned American English and struggle with linguistic diversity or nuances, reinforcing linguistic hierarchies.
